A Romani caravan-elder bone-knife hunter, late fifties, powerfully built despite his years, whose quiet authority and carved-bone blades speak a knowledge no academy could teach.
A prime-years Wallachian boyar turned vampire-killer, dark-bearded and broad-backed, whose aristocratic bearing and absolute focus make him the most dangerous man in any room.
A Norse-skald axe-and-rune hunter in his early thirties, clean-shaven and tall, whose rune-carved axe and cold northern calm make him a profoundly efficient instrument of destruction.
A Constantine occult-investigator, mid-thirties, lean and sharp-featured, moving through city understreets with a trenchcoat and the quietly forbidding manner of a man who has seen everything.
A young Greek-klepht silver-pistol hunter, late twenties, lean and dark, moving through mountain passes with two primed silver pistols and the unhesitating nerve of a born marksman.
A prime-years Eastern-Orthodox staritz hunter, broad and iron-calm in his early forties, whose monk's discipline has become something considerably more lethal than prayer alone.
A Bohemian alchemist-hunter, trim and precise in his mid-thirties, whose laboratory coat conceals consecrated silver tools and a killing knowledge refined through decades of cold empirical study.
A veteran Borgia-purged exorcist, late fifties, heavily built and scarred, carrying a breviary and a silver-headed mallet with the weary authority of a man who answers to no institution anymore.
A Mexican-vaquero silver-bola hunter in his early thirties, broad-shouldered and sun-darkened, whose coiled bola and flat-eyed focus belong to a man who has ridden this territory for years.
A Caribbean-privateer hunter in his prime, mid-thirties, square-jawed and ocean-hardened, whose cutlass is silver-edged and whose ship sails routes no honest captain would willingly chart.

A young Cathar last-of-the-purged-heresy hunter, twenty-six, lean and dark-eyed, carrying forbidden doctrine and consecrated weapons with the cold purpose of a lineage that survived by becoming dangerous.
